title: zKhorus
tagline: Tired of inactive DAOs? ZKhorus uses AI & zero-knowledge proofs to guarantee quorum & ensure your voice is heard, even if you miss a vote while being absolutely anonymous.
description:
ZKhorus is a revolutionary DAO platform that tackles the challenge of low voter participation. It leverages the power of AI and zero-knowledge proofs to ensure anonymity and guaranteed quorum.

Personalized AI bots: During onboarding, users answer sentiment-gauging questions. These responses are analyzed to create personalized AI bots that mirror their voting preferences.
Zero-knowledge proofs: Semaphore technology ensures anonymity while verifying votes, protecting user privacy.
Guaranteed quorum: If a user fails to vote, their AI bot casts a vote based on their preferences at the end of the proposal voting period, ensuring all voices are heard.

ZKhorus empowers DAOs by:

Maximizing participation: Eliminates concerns about privacy and inability to vote, leading to higher engagement.
Enhancing security: Zero-knowledge proofs safeguard anonymity and prevent vote manipulation.
Promoting transparency: Users can track their bot's voting activity and modify preferences anytime.
how_its_made:
Frontend: Built using a user-friendly framework (e.g., NextJS) for a seamless onboarding experience.
Backend: Uses FastAPI to communicate data between AI model and the smart contracts.
Sentiment Analysis: Employs a pre-trained NLP model like VADER to analyze user responses and quantify sentiment.
Zero-Knowledge Proofs: Utilizes Semaphore and Scroll deployment to implement anonymous voting mechanisms.
AI Bots: Machine learning algorithms (Random Forest and Regression) are used to train the bots based on user sentiment data.

Additionally:
Integration with existing DAO frameworks: ZKhorus can be designed to integrate with popular DAO platforms for wider adoption.
Scalability: The system is built with scalability in mind to accommodate a growing number of DAO members.
